besluite.fout: 'soek oor die hele bladsy' copies English 'search all over the page'
besluite.rede: 'oral op die bladsy' is the natural Afrikaans for searching everywhere on the page; same searcher, same page, same word count, nothing lost.

besluite.fout: 'om te sê presies waar' follows English word order
besluite.rede: In an om-te clause the adverb goes before 'te', and 'presies' still sharpens where the thing lies, so the meaning is unchanged.

besluite.fout: missing AWS 2017 comma before 'en' joining two full clauses
besluite.rede: 'Party lyne loop' and 'ander loop' each have their own subject and verb, so the comma is required; no words change.

besluite.fout: relative clause 'wat by die dam se blokkie hoort' first attaches to 'die kant', not to the letter
besluite.rede: The rewrite makes the letter clearly the thing that belongs to the dam's block, keeps the same action and the link to 'dieselfde blokkie' in the next sentence, and is one word shorter.

besluite.fout: 'eerste' used where Afrikaans uses the adverb 'eers' for doing one thing before another
besluite.rede: With 'daarna' in the same sentence the order is temporal, so 'eers' is the natural word, matches the lesson title, and the letter-then-number order is unchanged.
